senses.gloss: ch. same, to cut, split, break into; to chop, hash.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 74b:2">Sabb. 74ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דפָרֵים סילקא</he> (Var. in Ar. <he>דפָרֵיס</he>) he who minces beets (on the Sabbath).
<cite ref="Berakhot 39a:8">Ber. 39ᵃ</cite> <he>פַּרְמִינְהוּ פרימי רברבי</he> Ms. M. (Ar. <he>פירמי</he>, ed. <he>פרימא רבא</he>) if he chopped them into large pieces.

<cite ref="Moed Katan 25a">M. Kat. 25ᵃ</cite> <he>פָּרוּם בבא וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="Q01702"><he>פרוס</he></cite>; Ms. M. 2 <he>פרוץ</he>) they broke through the gate, and carried the body out; a. e.—V. <cite ref="Q01691"><he>פְּרוֹמָאָה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 30b">Ḥull. 30ᵇ</cite> sq. <he>חזינן גידפי דמִיפַּרְמֵי</he> we see that the feathers (of the throat) are cut through.
